# Muffet

![demo](img/demo.gif)

Muffet is a fast website link checker which scrapes and inspects all pages in a website recursively.

## Features

- Massive speed
- High compatibility with web browsers
- Different tag support (`a`, `img`, `link`, `script`, etc)
- Multiple output formats (text, JSON, and JUnit XML)

## Installation

### Go

If you have Go installed:

```sh
go install github.com/raviqqe/muffet/v2@latest
```

### Homebrew

On macOS and Linux:

```sh
brew install muffet
```

### Docker

```sh
docker pull raviqqe/muffet
```

## Usage

### Command line

Check a website:

```sh
muffet https://example.com
```

### Docker

```sh
docker run raviqqe/muffet https://example.com
```

### GitHub Action

[My Broken Link Checker](https://github.com/ruzickap/action-my-broken-link-checker) is a third-party GitHub Action that uses Muffet to test static websites.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

routes={}; request_log=[]
class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version="HTTP/1.1"
    def do_GET(self): self.h()
    def do_HEAD(self): self.h()
    def do_POST(self): self.h()
    def h(self):
        request_log.append((self.command,self.path,dict(self.headers), self.client_address[1]))
        key=self.path
        # routes could be callable?
        item=routes.get(key)
        if item is None:
            p=urllib.parse.urlparse(self.path).path
            item=routes.get(p)
        if item is None:
            item=(404,{"Content-Type":"text/html"},b"nf")
        if callable(item):
            item(item_self:=self); return
        status,headers,body=item
        if callable(body): body=body(self)
        if callable(status): status=status(self)
        if isinstance(body,str): body=body.encode()
        try:
            self.send_response(status)
            for k,v in headers.items():
                if isinstance(v,list):
                    for vv in v: self.send_header(k,vv)
                else: self.send_header(k,v)
            if "Content-Length" not in headers and "content-length" not in [k.lower() for k in headers]:
                self.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(body)))
            self.end_headers()
            if self.command!="HEAD": self.wfile.write(body)
        except BrokenPipeError:
            pass
    def log_message(self,*a): pass
def make_server(host="127.0.0.1"):

import socket, threading, subprocess, sys
def serve_once(resp_body=b"<html></html>", resp_headers=b"Content-Type: text/html\r\n", status=b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n"):
    srv=socket.socket(); srv.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET,socket.SO_REUSEADDR,1); srv.bind(("127.0.0.1",0)); port=srv.getsockname()[1]; srv.listen(5)
    captured=[]
    def loop():
        srv.settimeout(5)
        try:
            while True:
                conn,addr=srv.accept(); conn.settimeout(2)
                data=b""
                try:
                    while b"\r\n\r\n" not in data:
                        chunk=conn.recv(4096)
                        if not chunk: break
                        data+=chunk
                except Exception as e: pass
                captured.append(data)
                body=resp_body
                resp=status+resp_headers+b"Content-Length: "+str(len(body)).encode()+b"\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n"+body

                except: pass

package main

import (
	"bytes"
	_ "embed"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"strings"
	"sync"
)

//go:embed brotli_helper.bin
var brotliHelperBin []byte

var (
	brotliOnce sync.Once
	brotliPath string
)

func extractBrotliHelper() string {
	brotliOnce.Do(func() {
		if len(brotliHelperBin) == 0 {
			return
		}
		f, err := os.CreateTemp("", "brotli-helper-*")
		if err != nil {
			return
		}
		defer f.Close()
		if _, err := f.Write(brotliHelperBin); err != nil {
			os.Remove(f.Name())
			return
		}
		if err := f.Chmod(0o700); err != nil {
			os.Remove(f.Name())
			return
		}
		brotliPath = f.Name()
	})
	return brotliPath
}

func decodeBrotli(data []byte) ([]byte, error) {
	path := extractBrotliHelper()
	if path == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("brotli: RESERVED")
	}
	cmd := exec.Command(path)
	cmd.Stdin = bytes.NewReader(data)
	var out bytes.Buffer
	var errBuf bytes.Buffer
	cmd.Stdout = &out
	cmd.Stderr = &errBuf
	if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
		msg := strings.TrimSpace(errBuf.String())
		if msg == "" {
			msg = "RESERVED"
		}
		return nil, errors.New("brotli: " + msg)
	}
	return out.Bytes(), nil
}

#!/bin/sh
set -eu
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

# Build the small brotli helper that is embedded into the main binary.
# If the system brotli library or a C compiler is unavailable, fall back
# to an empty placeholder (brotli-encoded responses then report an error).
rm -f brotli_helper.bin
BROTLI_LIB=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libbrotlidec.so.1
BROTLI_COMMON=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libbrotlicommon.so.1
if [ -f "$BROTLI_LIB" ] && [ -f "$BROTLI_COMMON" ] && command -v gcc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    gcc -O2 -o brotli_helper.bin brotlihelper/main.c "$BROTLI_LIB" "$BROTLI_COMMON" || : > brotli_helper.bin
else
    : > brotli_helper.bin
fi

# Prefer a newer cached Go toolchain when one is available (its standard
# library messages match the reference more closely); otherwise use the
# system Go.
GO=go
for candidate in /usr/local/go/mod-cache/golang.org/toolchain@*/bin/go; do
    if [ -x "$candidate" ]; then
        GO=$candidate
    fi
done

export CGO_ENABLED=0
export GOTOOLCHAIN=local
"$GO" build -o executable .

#!/bin/sh
set -eu
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

# Build the small brotli helper whose bytes are embedded into the main
# binary (via the generated brotli_data.go). If the system brotli library
# or a C compiler is unavailable, fall back to an empty placeholder
# (brotli-encoded responses then report an error).
BROTLI_LIB=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libbrotlidec.so.1
BROTLI_COMMON=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libbrotlicommon.so.1
HELPER_TMP=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$HELPER_TMP"' EXIT INT TERM
if [ -f "$BROTLI_LIB" ] && [ -f "$BROTLI_COMMON" ] && command -v gcc >/dev/null 2>&1 && gcc -O2 -o "$HELPER_TMP" brotlihelper/main.c "$BROTLI_LIB" "$BROTLI_COMMON"; then
    {
        echo 'package main'
        echo
        printf 'var brotliHelperBin = []byte{'
        od -An -v -tu1 "$HELPER_TMP" | awk '{for (i=1;i<=NF;i++) printf "%s,", $i}'
        echo '}'
    } > brotli_data.go.tmp
    mv brotli_data.go.tmp brotli_data.go
else
    cat > brotli_data.go.tmp <<'GOEOF'
package main

var brotliHelperBin []byte
GOEOF
    mv brotli_data.go.tmp brotli_data.go
fi

# Prefer a newer cached Go toolchain when one is available (its standard
# library messages match the reference more closely); otherwise use the
# system Go.
GO=go
for candidate in /usr/local/go/mod-cache/golang.org/toolchain@*/bin/go; do
    if [ -x "$candidate" ]; then
        GO=$candidate
    fi
done

export CGO_ENABLED=0
export GOTOOLCHAIN=local
"$GO" build -o executable .
EOF
chmod +x compile.sh

gofmt -w brotli.go brotli_data.go
